name: The Fate of Zephras
label: Quest
description: The Fate of Zephras: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.
High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... Decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.
There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
